source_text: Lot ascendit in montem, habitat in spelunca cum filiabus. Consilium filiarum de semine — ebrietas patris. Narratio turpis littera; spiritaliter cave.
pass_a_gloss: Lot went-up into mountain, dwells in cave with daughters. Counsel of-daughters about seed — drunkenness of-father. Narration shameful by-letter; spiritually beware.
pass_b_english: [[Lot goes up the mountain and dwells in a cave with his daughters >> Bible:Genesis 19:30]]. The daughters’ plan for seed and the father’s drunkenness: shameful by the letter; spiritually, beware the cave of hidden passion.
